note: Description taken from Holmgren's 1910 original description of Eutermes Ephratae (in German), including the alate and (probably minor) worker; no soldier is described. Type locality Ephrata, Surinam. The original is in German and the BHL scan OCR is only moderate: decimal points are often misread as commas or colons and some measurement digits are blurred; blurred values are not cited. The species was then placed in Eutermes and is now in Nasutitermes.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Very close to E. chaquimayensis, differing in the sparser and shorter cephalic pilosity, the larger and more prominent compound eyes, and antennal segment 3 almost equal to segment 2 or only slightly longer (in the latter species segment 3 is far longer than segment 2); head width greater (1.44 mm), the anterior corners of the transverse band slightly projecting.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: The description is given mainly as a comparison with E. chaquimayensis: the cephalic pilosity is not as dense and long as in that species, the compound eyes are larger and more prominent; antennal segment 3 is equal to segment 2 or imperceptibly longer, segment 4 equal to segment 3 or slightly shorter. Measurements: body length (with wings) 12.5—13.0 mm; head length 1.66 mm; head width 1.44 mm; from the anterior margin of the transverse band to the occiput 1.0 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head brown, slightly glossy; head capsule sutures, postclypeus, labrum, mandible bases, region around the antennae, antennae and the rest of the body straw-yellow to rusty yellow. Head sparsely bristled, abdominal tergites more densely hairy with longer bristles on the posterior margins. Head shape as usual; sagittal suture very narrow; frontal marks sharply delimited, twice as long as wide; postclypeus shorter than half its width. Antennae 14-segmented: segment 3 equal to segment 2, segment 4 far shorter, segment 5 slightly longer than segment 4. Anterior margin of the pronotum not concave. Measurements: body length 4.5 mm; head length 1.03 mm; head width 0.86 mm.
